learning_objective: 🎯 Use your magic mind to draw dream worlds, funny creatures, and things that no one has ever seen before!

main_concepts.concept_title: 💭 Your Mind is a Magic Wand
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Imagination means seeing pictures inside your head! In art, you don't always have to copy real things. You can draw exactly what you dream about.
What if trees were made of pink cotton candy and cars could fly? You can mix real things with magic ideas to create wonderful fantasy places.
Colors and shapes can show how you feel. Bright yellow can mean you are happy, and zigzag red lines can show excitement or energy!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Super-Animal Mashup!
fun_activity.instructions: Close your eyes and imagine mixing three different animals together. Now draw your new super-animal, give it a funny name, and color it with the brightest colors you have!

quick_recap: ⭐ Imagination helps artists create brand new worlds that have never existed.
⭐ There are zero mistakes when you are drawing from your own dreams.
⭐ We can use special colors and shapes to show our feelings on paper.
